display_name: Mini Golf Mania: Mixed Reality Mini Golf
display_long_description:
Hey mini-golf enthusiasts - dive into a whole new dimension of putting action with Mini Golf Mania (MGM for short) — this ultimate MR mini-golf sandbox game is redefining the joy of mini-golf putting.

**Powerful and creative mini-golf sandbox editor**

With Mini Golf Mania’s sandbox editor, you can craft the mini-golf levels of your dreams. Use straight paths, ramps, looped tracks, and a wide variety of functionality modules and obstacles, paired with multiple themed decorations — imagination is your only limitation.

[media]

**Enjoy the comfort and convenience of mixed reality**

Mini Golf Mania transform your living room or backyard into a personalized course. As rich course challenges unfold in your home space, you can enjoy MR mini-golf fun while watching TV, taking care of pets, or keeping an eye on the kids.

[media]

**Library of themed challenges in both VR and MR**

Mini Golf Mania boasts a curated library of vibrant, themed maps that are regularly updated that can be played both in VR and MR. A roguelike mode will also be added in the future — every round will be a fresh, thrilling adventure.

[media]

Mini Golf Mania is waiting to turn your space into the ultimate mini-golf playground. Don’t just play mini-golf—reimagine it!
